notes.title: Forevermore: Prequel Novella to Life Eternal Now Available
notes.notes:
Fellow Necromancers and Sorcerers,

Thank you all for enjoying Life Eternal, we're so glad that this short little game has resonated with so many of you. While our little blossom's adventures thereafter are up to your interpretation, he and his Lord do have a history that has been put to paper...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763785/852ca0ec0c9aa4c10bbcee99986d91b04e206f4c.png[/img]

[quote]Up-and-coming necromancer, Nezael, has lived a quiet, solitary life with his lord, the Great Sorcerer Carrow deep in the woods of thorns and brambles to hide from those seeking to hurt them.

For a time, Nezael was content, but now that he is ever closer to becoming a necromancer in his own right, he finds he wants more than this life. In that desire for more, he finds Yorick, a handsome woodsman from the nearby town…

Forevermore is a 40,000 word fantasy novella featuring:
[list]
[*] M/M Romance
[*] Handsome Woodsman x Flighty Necromancer
[*] Skeletons as Family
[*] Necromancy Magic
[*] Tragedy
[/list][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763785/ad4e5a35febe535ec39e448569123a1740343523.png[/img]

Forevermore is currently available as a digital ebook, and will be available in paperback format at retailers such as Amazon and Barnes & Noble starting May 27, 2024. You can view the [url=https://books2read.com/forevermoresjean]Books2Read page[/url] for more information.

Thank you all again for the support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763785/9a8c744ce8472b349e22b980d3effae73b46e5d9.png[/img]
